data.title: mTORC1 controls fasting-induced ketogenesis and its modulation by ageing
data.authors: Sengupta S; Sabatini DM et al.

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.finding: mTORC1 controls fasting-induced hepatic ketogenesis via PPARalpha, and this is blunted with age.
data.abstract_excerpt: The multi-component mechanistic target of rapamycin complex 1 (mTORC1) kinase is the central node of a mammalian pathway that coordinates cell growth with the availability of nutrients, energy and growth factors. Progress has been made in the identification of mTORC1 pathway components and in understanding their functions in cells, but there is relatively little known about the role of the pathway in vivo. Specifically, we have little knowledge regarding the role mTORC1 has in liver physiology.

extracted_findings.effect: mTORC1 controls fasting-induced ketogenesis (via PPARα); this control is blunted with ageing
